rationale: Medium contract with PK/FK markers, owner set, enums for currency/status. correctness=4 (good): types good, PK declared, FK referenced, enums constrain values. completeness=3 (acceptable): owner + layer + productType set; no SLA, no retention, no refresh cadence (the canonical 'minimum viable' floor). security=2 (below acceptable): no PII tagging on account_id despite being a linkable identifier. governance=4 (good): owner + team contactable, but no access policies or retention declared. performance=2: TIMESTAMP columns present but no clustering/partition for a transaction-volume table. documentation=3: layer + productType + enum values give context (data dictionary surfaces values), but no per-column free-text descriptions.
